name: Opengeni
summary: AI agents that do meeting prep, weekly reports, lead follow-ups and pull requests in your team’s tools (Gmail, Slack, GitHub and others), and check with you before anything goes out. Open source (Apache 2.0). Made in Norway.
description: AI agents that do meeting prep, weekly reports, lead follow-ups and pull requests in your team’s tools (Gmail, Slack, GitHub and others), and check with you before anything goes out. Open source (Apache 2.0). Made in Norway.

pricing.details: Free 0 €/month — 9 € of trial credit every month for eligible accounts and free-credit models in the app, 3 seats, top-ups never expire (ChatGPT or SuperGrok subscription not included). Pro 18 €/month — 90 € of usage every month (5× what you pay), 5 seats, can connect your ChatGPT or SuperGrok subscription. Max 90 €/month — 452 € of usage, 10 seats. Enterprise custom (SSO, managed cloud or self-hosted VPC). Self-host: free, no license fee, full platform. Made in Norway.
pricing.label: Freemium
